Container.Name: nexus-archivist
Container.Overview: Scheduled HentaiNexus CBZ archivist. Set a search query in the web UI or HN_TAGS, map a library folder, and it writes missing galleries as CBZ with ComicInfo.xml. Uses public gallery and read pages. Does not call the login zip endpoint. Blocked tags are always skipped.
Container.Requires: Replace YOUR_USER in Repository. After the first Actions build, make the GHCR package public so Unraid can pull it.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Where CBZ files are written. Do not point this at the nhentai library.

Config.Name: HN_TAGS
Config.Description: Search query, same syntax as the site. Example: artist:"Aomushi" or tag:uncensored. Empty waits for the web UI.

Config.Name: SLEEP_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Seconds to wait after a cycle

Config.Name: LIBRARY_SPLIT
Config.Description: Split into folders of this many ids. 0 = flat.

Config.Name: CATCH_UP_STREAK
Config.Description: Stop a cycle after this many already-have galleries in a row. 0 = walk every search page.

Config.Name: MAX_PER_CYCLE
Config.Description: Cap new CBZs per cycle. 0 = unlimited.

Config.Name: REQUEST_DELAY_MS
Config.Description: Pause between HTML requests. Raise if you see 429.

Config.Name: MAX_SEARCH_PAGES
Config.Description: Hard cap on search pages per cycle. 0 = unlimited.

Config.Name: COOKIE
Config.Description: Optional browser Cookie header if Cloudflare returns 403.

Config.Name: LIBRARY_IMPORT_KEY
Config.Description: If set, POST /api/import requires header X-Api-Key.

Config.Name: STATUS_PORT
Config.Description: Port inside the container. Match the WebUI host port.
